column1: # Phase 0.5 trace v0 walk legs. One leg per row; the port and retail sides both start the body at
# the row's pose (eye convention, as tools/parity/shots.tsv) and hold forward for the same game time.
# name <TAB> level <TAB> x <TAB> y <TAB> z <TAB> pitch <TAB> yaw
# walk_cantina is route_cantina turned 180 degrees: level 1's cantina pose facing yaw 105. The port
# walks into furniture around x -3.98 and retail into its own at x -4.37, so it measures the start
# pose and the resting height but not a steady speed.
# walk_street45 is the flat straight run: 2.21 units in 3 s in the port, z within 0.01, four sectors.
# Retail crosses 271 -> 157 -> 155 and stops at x 3.27 (furniture); the port keeps going and steps
# off a ledge there, so the leg also measures that collision difference (thing collision is absent).
